cross_disciplinary_pairing.description: An offline advisory model for Togolese smallholder farmers and extension officers. It gives practical crop, livestock, weather and market guidance grounded in Togo's national services (ICAT, ITRA, ANAMET, ANSAT, CAGIA, SIM), so it works in rural areas with no internet.

test_prompts.prompt: My tomato leaves have tiny white insects underneath and are turning yellow. What is wrong and what should I do?
My cattle are weak and feverish, with pale gums and many ticks. What could it be and how do I treat them?

model.name: adtc-agritgllm-adviser-v3-Q4_K_M
model._note_weights: The Hugging Face commit that holds the file above; the same SHA is pinned in download_model.sh. The repository name still says v2 because it is the container we created for Round 2; the file inside is v3.

recommended_sampling._note: Liquid AI's recommendation for the LFM2 family. All figures in REPORT.md section 5 were measured with these values on the target machine.

reproducibility._note_seed: Training and split seed, the one in provenance/config.py and provenance/train_config.json. The seed 42 quoted in provenance/evaluation/ is the llama.cpp sampling seed used to generate the answer files; the two are different things.
reproducibility._note_sha: Commit of this repository that holds every file the report describes; it is written after that commit exists, so it points one commit behind HEAD.
